stringUnit.value: 这条认领申请的据点编号或状态无法核实，请重新读取后再试。
This claim’s node identity or status could not be verified. Reload before trying again.
撤回成功后，这条待审认领申请会被取消，据点将重新开放认领。平台已接手审核的申请可能无法撤回。
After successful withdrawal, this pending claim is cancelled and the node becomes available for claiming again. A claim already under platform review may no longer be withdrawn.
